name: National Kidney Foundation of Malaysia
summary: Runs subsidised dialysis for low-income kidney patients and works on kidney disease prevention, education and research.
programmes: Patient welfare: counselling and treatment subsidies
Training centre for renal care staff
beneficiaries: Low-income kidney failure patients needing dialysis, and the public at risk of kidney disease

organisation.founders: Formally established 16 Jan 1970, sponsored by the Rotary Club of Petaling Jaya; first President Tan Sri Haji Sardon bin Haji Jubir; nephrologist Dr S.S. Gill's experiences led to its formation
organisation.leadership: Tan Sri Dato' Dr Abu Bakar bin Suleiman (President, Council of Governors); Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr Jeffrey Cheah, AO (Deputy President); Dato' Dr Zaki Morad bin Mohd Zaher (Chairman, Board of Directors); Choo Kok Ming (Chief Executive Officer, listed as Management Team 2025)

taxExemption.statement: Not stated on site. Court reporting: held 44(6)(a) status since 1970; IRB revoked it 29 Aug 2019; Shah Alam High Court quashed the revocation on 28 Nov 2024. No current LHDN reference printed.

contact.address: 70, Jalan 14/29, 46100 Petaling Jaya, Selangor Darul Ehsan

live.note: YouTube channel linked from site (https://www.youtube.com/nkfmy), incl. 50th anniversary video; live streaming not verified

donationsToday: Online via FPX (Curlec) and credit/debit card, monthly Direct Debit Donor Programme, e-wallets, bank transfer, merchandise and campaign giving, telemarketing
